stateHint.off: The VPN runs on the server: deploy it with DEPLOY_VPN=yes (see the steps below).
stateHint.starting: The server made its keys; the VPN container answers within a minute or two.
stateHint.up: Devices connect to this address. All their traffic goes through your server.
stateHint.down: The VPN container has not answered for over 3 minutes: devices cannot connect.
stateHint.remote: The VPN runs on the server; this computer syncs with it. Devices added, renamed or deleted here change on the server. Who is online and the traffic are on the server's page.

devices.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its key stops opening the VPN within a minute.

config.qrAlt: The QR code of the VPN for {{name}}
config.failed: The config could not be loaded.
config.phoneHint: In AmneziaWG: + → Scan from QR code.
config.computerHint: Download the file and in AmneziaWG: Import tunnel(s) from file. Or scan the QR code with a phone.
config.secret: This holds the device's key: whoever sees it can use your VPN. Do not send it in chats.

phone.1: Install AmneziaWG from Google Play (or AmneziaVPN — it reads the same QR code).
phone.2: Here: Add a device → Phone, then in the app: + → Scan from QR code.
phone.3: Turn it on: the device's dot here turns green within a minute.
phone.4: Without internet when the VPN is off: in the phone's VPN settings (on Xiaomi: Connection & sharing → VPN) → AmneziaWG → Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN.

computer.1: Install the AmneziaWG client for Windows from its GitHub releases.
computer.2: Here: Add a device → Computer → File .conf; in the client: Import tunnel(s) from file → Activate.
computer.3: All traffic goes through the tunnel, so the client blocks the internet while the VPN is off (its "Block untunneled traffic" is on by itself).

server.1: Add a DNS A record vpn.<your domain> → the server's IP at your domain's registrar. Moving the VPN to another IP later changes only this record.
server.2: Put DEPLOY_VPN=yes into deploy/deploy.local.env and deploy: the server builds the VPN, opens UDP 37853 and starts it.
server.3: The protocol is AmneziaWG: WireGuard whose packets a DPI does not recognise, with settings of its own made for your server.

errors.full: All 253 addresses of the VPN are taken: delete a device you do not use.
errors.no-server: The VPN is not set up on the server yet.
errors.refused: The server refused it: no free address, or no VPN on it.
errors.gone: This device is gone already: the page is refreshed.
errors.offline: No connection to the server: try again in a moment.
errors.generic: It did not work: try again in a moment.

computer.title: This computer
computer.noAmnezia: Install AmneziaWG for Windows: the dashboard switches the VPN through it.
computer.setupHint: Windows asks for the administrator once: the app sets up its two tunnels and may then switch them by itself, from here and later by a command.
computer.killSwitch: No internet when the VPN fails
computer.killSwitchOn: While the VPN is on, nothing goes around it: if the server or the connection to it fails, the internet is off until the VPN is back or switched off.
computer.killSwitchOff: If the VPN fails, the internet goes on without it.
computer.others: AmneziaWG's own window has a tunnel on ({{names}}): switch it off there — two at once fight over the traffic.
computer.canceled: Windows did not get the administrator's consent: nothing changed.
computer.failed: It did not work: try again, or set it up again.
